targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  sql_timestamp div 60 * 60 as time,
  instance_role,
  concat(instance_host, ":", instance_port) as instance,
  count(*) as value
FROM tb_mysql_slow_log 
WHERE cluster_domain = '$cluster_domain'
AND instance_role = '$instance_role'
AND sql_timestamp >= $__unixEpochFrom() and sql_timestamp <= $__unixEpochTo()
GROUP BY time,instance_role,instance_host,instance_port
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT 
  sql_timestamp div 60 * 60 as time,
  CONCAT(query_digest_md5, ' > ', LEFT(ANY_VALUE(query_digest_text), 60)) as metric,
  count(*) as value
FROM tb_mysql_slow_log 
WHERE cluster_domain = '$cluster_domain'
AND instance_role = '$instance_role'
AND sql_timestamp >= $__unixEpochFrom() and sql_timestamp <= $__unixEpochTo()
AND db_name like $db
GROUP BY time,query_digest_md5
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT 
  sql_timestamp div 60 * 60 as time,

  sum(rows_examined) as value
FROM tb_mysql_slow_log 
WHERE cluster_domain = '$cluster_domain'
AND instance_role = '$instance_role'

AND db_name like $db

SELECT 
  sql_timestamp div 60 * 60 as time,
  CONCAT(query_digest_md5, ' > ', LEFT(ANY_VALUE(query_digest_text), 60)) as metric,
  sum(query_time) as value
FROM tb_mysql_slow_log 
WHERE cluster_domain = '$cluster_domain'
AND instance_role = '$instance_role'
AND sql_timestamp >= $__unixEpochFrom() and sql_timestamp <= $__unixEpochTo()
AND db_name like $db
GROUP BY time,query_digest_md5
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT dteventtimestamp,query_time,rows_examined,rows_sent,username,
 db_name,query_digest_md5, query_digest_text, query_string,
 instance_host,instance_port,instance_role,client_host,session_id,query_command,table_names
FROM tb_mysql_slow_log 
WHERE cluster_domain = '$cluster_domain'
AND instance_role = '$instance_role'
AND sql_timestamp >= $__unixEpochFrom() and sql_timestamp <= $__unixEpochTo()
AND db_name like $db
AND query_digest_md5 like '$digest'
ORDER BY sql_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1000
